title: Emfit QS Sleep HRV RMSSD Leaderboard
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=emfit:sleep hrv_rmssd=*
| stats sum(hrv_rmssd) as total_value, avg(hrv_rmssd) as avg_value by bed_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks bed values by total and average hrv rmssd across Emfit QS sleep events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `hrv_rmssd` values for each Emfit QS sleep event and review total and average hrv rmssd by bed.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total hrv rmssd.
grandmaExplanation: It will rank which bed shows the biggest hrv rmssd numbers in your Emfit QS sleep data.
